articles.title: The 345-Million-Year-Old Fossil That Fooled Scientists for Decades
articles.summary: Lizzie the fossil looked like an early reptile, but X-ray scans show it was a water-dwelling animal with gills and a fish-like mouth.

articles.title: Hidden Lakes a Mile Under the Red Sea Are Full of Life
articles.summary: Scientists found super-salty underwater lakes in the Red Sea where microbes thrive without oxygen, and the pools also preserve clues to ancient tsunamis.

articles.title: How 100 Starlings Took Over a Continent, and What They Teach Us About Evolution
articles.summary: About 100 starlings released in Central Park grew into millions, and studying their tiny differences helps scientists understand fast evolution.
